messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: auto-paging triggered — elevated p95 in us-west inference tier, throughput down ~20% vs baseline over last 8m. Paging to #incidents and @oncall.
ash: Picking up. I'm looking; initial metrics show spike in token queue and increased KV eviction in kvproxy-usw2. Paging SRE + runtime.
lucy: Confirming. Not seeing CPU/GPU saturation. Token backpressure in proxy layer; batch sizes are shrinking. KV hit rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.58. Possible cache churn from a misbehaving customer job.
ash: :point_right: mitigation idea — enable prefix caching bypass for long-tail traffic and throttle per-project max-conn to 10 on the region. Will apply short policy.
jamal: Applying per-project conn throttle and temporary lower max-batch to 8 to reduce latency. Will patch routing to prefer dedicated pools w/ warmed KV.
ash: Rolling config now: `curl -X POST /ops/configs/apply -d '{"region":"us-west","policy":"throttle-10,mb=8"}'` -> response 202
oncall-bot: Deploy event: config-rollout/5290019900 by jamal started.
leah: Are customers impacted? Which accounts? I can draft a status page blurb.
lucy: Impact: increased p95 (1.2s -> 1.8s) for ~5% of requests in us-west. No errors, retries increased 0.5%. Affected: projects with long-context ops and heavy concurrent small requests. Tentative list: acct-alpha, acct-gamma (investigating).
leah: Draft status page: 'We are investigating elevated latency in US-West for inference requests affecting a subset of customers. Mitigation actions are in progress. No customer-facing errors observed. ETA to recovery: 30-45m.' Need edits.
nash: Add note: 'Mitigation: temporary per-project connection caps and reduced batching to restore KV hit rate. Expected reduction in throughput variance.'
carla: If we notify customers, mention recommended workaround: reduce client concurrency or pin to other region if possible.
jamal: Config applied; observing gradual KV hit-rate recovery 0.62 -> 0.78 in 2m. p95 trending down 1.8 -> 1.4.
lucy: Monitoring: token queue length dropping, queues_backpressure metric down 35%.
nash: :white_check_mark: Moving to status: Investigating -> Mitigating. Leah pls post status page and send 1-line customer note to acct-contacts for alpha/gamma. I'll stay on until stable.
leah: Posting status now and sending targeted emails. Email snippet: 'We're currently mitigating elevated latency in US-West. Actions: temporary connection caps and reduced batching. No data loss. We expect restoration in ~30m. We'll update in 15m or sooner.'
oncall-bot: Status update posted -> status.redwood.ai/incidents/5290019876 (internal).
jamal: p95 now 1.1s, KV hit-rate 0.85. Restoring batch size to normal, removing temporary cap for non-impacted projects in 5m.
nash: If stable for 15m, we'll close and create follow-up doc for root cause analysis. Preliminary RCA: noisy high-concurrency job causing cache churn + routing hotspot.
lucy: Noted. Assigning RCA to runtime+proxy team. I'll open tracker ticket.
